## Dispatch packet P22
Read initiative videoml-dbc2b1 sections D09,D10 before editing. Those are binding decisions, not suggestions.

## Repositories and edit scope
Babulus
Primary paths: apps/studio-web/amplify/functions/render-trigger; coordinator/outbox. Read repository AGENTS before any edits. Do not edit unrelated product code.

## Procedure
1. Read prerequisites and existing implementation at the paths above.
2. Add failing behavioral fixtures for the listed acceptance cases.
3. Change stream trigger to enqueue only. One scheduler checks deadline, CAS-reserves cloud ownership and writes durable outbox. No batch or ECS launch outside coordinator. Migration first disables old trigger path; rollback cloud-disabled.
4. Run scoped checks plus required repo quality gates. Save actual commands, exit status and artifacts in an issue comment.
5. Return the diff and evidence to the primary reviewer; do not close the issue yourself.

## Acceptance
pre-deadline stream tests prove zero paid launches; old retry path cannot bypass reservation.

## Dependencies
videoml-811fde (P21), videoml-e68602 (P19)

## Stop conditions
Do not guess a missing credential/account identity, bypass a failed test, substitute mocked evidence for a real smoke run, expand product scope, or change contract defaults. Report a precise blocker and return to the primary reviewer. A passing build alone is insufficient for rendering behavior.

## Accepted review correction
D09a is authoritative. Read D11/D12 as well. Atomically reserve customer credit, operator budget, global capacity, ownership and durable outbox; depend on P25. Add crash-point replay and orphan reconciliation tests; no distributed best-effort sequence of debits.
## Required authority/cutover decision
Read initiative D09b. Separate server-owned rendering tables and API in the dedicated account are authoritative; preserve non-render Amplify jobs, disable all legacy render writers, and never attempt cross-account DynamoDB transactions. P18 defines the shared transition/transaction interface before P21/P25 implement it.

## Required authority/cutover decision
Read initiative D09b. Separate server-owned rendering tables and API in the dedicated account are authoritative; preserve non-render Amplify jobs, disable all legacy render writers, and never attempt cross-account DynamoDB transactions. P18 defines the shared transition/transaction interface before P21/P25 implement it.

## Required explicit migration/cutover command
Complete the apply portion of the P18 legacy inventory contract (Babulus scripts/inventory-legacy-renders.mjs and docs/render-authority.md). Provide a separate explicit operator command with dry-run/report by default; require exact reviewed input digest, dedicated target account identity and idempotency record for apply. Inventory every legacy render writer/trigger and in-flight job, then disable paid legacy dispatch and drain/cancel with authoritative status checks before new Batch admission. Preserve non-render jobs and all existing outputs. Never silently re-enqueue old unfenced render jobs into paid attempts or run dual writers. Fault/replay tests must prove no duplicate operation/charge/output loss, and failure leaves both paid admission paths disabled. Actual cloud apply requires later authorized cutover; source command and tests are mandatory before P22/P28 acceptance.
